rules-found.alt: The Rules app: the rule files read from main (CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md, REVIEW.md, .cursor/BUGBOT.md), and each rule with where it came from, its severity and what reviews did with it

ledger.alt: Rules checked on one pull request: 9 passed, 2 broken, 1 not checked, each rule with the line it broke on or why it couldn't be checked

finding-on-line.alt: A must-fix finding under line 82 of billing/queue.py: a retry can charge twice, the rule it breaks from CONTRIBUTING.md:42, the suggested change, and Fix it, Not worth fixing, The finding is wrong

second-push.alt: Since round 1: a finding fixed in the commit that fixed it, a dismissed one that stays dismissed, and nothing new on lines the push didn't touch

inbox.alt: The inbox by who each pull request waits on: Needs your review, Ready for you to merge, Merging by itself with Hold, Returned to you, Waiting on others, Reviewing now

lemma-check.alt: The Lemma check: posted on every pull request, required by branch protection on acme/api, and the merge box reading it beside GitHub's own checks
